name: Empower Trap (Metaconstruction)
body:
You can increase the power of your traps, causing them to deal more damage.

Benefit: All variable, numeric effects of an empowered trap are increased by half, including bonuses to those dice rolls.

Saving throws and opposed rolls are not affected, nor are traps without random variables. An empowered trap uses up a trap slot two levels higher than the trap’s actual level.
